title: Clinic appointment booking and day export
name: Clinic appointment booking

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code handles errors from the calls it makes? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
In appt_book, a second caller books an overlapping slot for the same clinician at nearly the same moment. How does this code stop both bookings from succeeding?
choices: The overlap count is read first and the INSERT is protected by a UNIQUE constraint on starts_at
BEGIN IMMEDIATE takes the database write lock before the overlap check, so the second caller waits (or fails to begin) until the first has committed or rolled back
sqlite3_last_insert_rowid detects the collision after the insert
count_overlaps locks the matching rows with SELECT ... FOR UPDATE

questions.prompt: When sqlite3_step fails in count_overlaps with an error code other than SQLITE_ROW, what does the caller see?
choices: APPT_OK, because the count stays at its initial value of zero
APPT_ERR_CONFLICT, because the count is unknown
APPT_ERR_DB after the transaction is rolled back
The function crashes because stmt is finalized twice

questions.prompt: The export builds the file at path.tmp and renames it onto path at the end. What is the main purpose of this design?
choices: Readers of path never see a half-written file, because rename replaces it in one step
It lets the export run without holding a database read transaction
It makes fprintf faster by writing to a temporary location
It avoids needing to check return values of fprintf
